purpose: Locked GRIB field contract for the downburst predictor experiment (criterion 9). Verified on HRRR 2023-06-15 12Z f30/f31.
window: Day 2: 12Z HRRR f24-f48; valid hour [H,H+1) uses instantaneous fields at fH (H=24..47) and hourly-max fields at f(H+1), exactly like the existing UH convention

maxuw.units: m s-1 (NCEP local table 2-222: U of hourly max 10 m wind)

maxvw.units: m s-1 (NCEP local table 2-223: V of hourly max 10 m wind)

maxdvv.units: m s-1, negative downward (NCEP local 2-221: hourly max downward vertical velocity)

index: entire atmosphere (considered as a single layer)

maxref1km.units: dBZ (NCEP local 16-198: hourly max 1 km reflectivity)

excluded.hgt_lcl: HGT at LCL has missing values (5,712 points in one f30 message); replaced by 2 m dewpoint depression as the sub-cloud dryness measure

features.wind10_max: 24-h max of hourly max 10 m wind speed = hypot(MAXUW, MAXVW) from the same hourly message, at the point
features.wind10_nearby_max: 24-h max of the 25-mile native-grid disk max of that hourly speed
features.gust_max: 24-h max of GUST at the point
features.gust_nearby_max: 24-h max of the 25-mile disk max of GUST
features.downdraft_nearby_max: 24-h max of the 25-mile disk max of -MAXDVV
features.dd2m_max: 24-h max of (TMP 2 m - DPT 2 m), K
features.maxref1km_max: 24-h max of hourly max 1 km reflectivity at the point
features.ltng_max: 24-h max of LTNG at the point

population_sensitivity.source: US Census 2020 centers of population by tract (CenPop2020_Mean_TR.txt), fetched once in Actions and pinned by SHA-256
population_sensitivity.feature: log1p(sum of tract populations whose population centroid lies within 40.2336 km of the sample)
